title: Action result
description: What the phone reports back after running an action. On `success`, `data` matches the action's `result` schema. On `failed`, `error` says why in plain words and `data.code` names the failure (one of the action's `errors`). `cancelled` means the rep declined the action on its card.

ref.description: Identifies the action request this result answers. Text transport: `<assistant message id>:<index of the action block in that message>`.

data.description: On success: the action's result. On failure: at least `code`, plus any details the failure carries.

error.description: On failure: why, in plain words.
